lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are distributed in a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the gill slits. The centroids follow distinct horizontal and vertical alignments across the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible superior to the gill slits, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge and a shadow-induced lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher density of smaller, more tightly packed high-luminance blobs compared to the larger, more dispersed clusters on the lateral flank.
